title: NEET UG 2026: Paper Leak, Cancellation & Re-Exam
shortDescription: NTA cancelled the 3 May 2026 NEET UG exam over paper-leak allegations affecting over 20 lakh candidates; a re-exam ('Re-NEET 2026') was held on 21 June 2026 with a CBI probe ordered.
genZNote: One exam, two exam dates, one CBI FIR — if a question mentions 'Re-NEET 2026', it's asking about THIS.

sections.heading: What Happened
sections.body: NEET UG 2026, held on 3 May 2026, was cancelled by the National Testing Agency (NTA) after allegations that a leaked "guess paper" closely matched the actual question paper, including over 120 matching Biology questions. The Central Government ordered a CBI investigation, and NTA conducted a re-examination — "Re-NEET 2026" — on 21 June 2026.

sections.heading: Key Facts
bullets: Original exam date: 3 May 2026. Cancellation announced: 12 May 2026 (following CBI/agency review).
The CBI registered an FIR covering criminal conspiracy, cheating, and breach of trust.
Re-NEET 2026 held on 21 June 2026 — no fresh registration required, fees fully refunded for the cancelled attempt.
For the re-exam, NTA extended the exam window from 180 to 195 minutes (2:00 PM-5:15 PM) and increased rough-work pages in the question booklet from 2 to 4.
Over 20-24 lakh candidates were affected by the cancellation.

sections.heading: Why It Matters
sections.body: NEET is the single largest medical entrance exam in India and a recurring GK/current-affairs topic — a cancellation and re-exam of this scale (and the resulting exam-format changes) is exactly the kind of concrete, dated development the exam's own Education & NEET category exists to test.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: NEET UG 2026 (3 May) was cancelled over a paper leak and re-conducted as 'Re-NEET 2026' on 21 June 2026, with the exam duration extended to 195 minutes.
keyFacts: CBI FIR registered over the paper leak.
commonConfusion: 3 May 2026 is the CANCELLED original date; 21 June 2026 is the actual RE-EXAM date — don't cite the wrong one as 'the' NEET 2026 date.

highYieldFacts: 195-minute duration and 4 rough-work pages are the two concrete format changes introduced for Re-NEET 2026.
commonTraps: Citing 3 May 2026 as the date NEET UG 2026 was actually conducted — that attempt was cancelled.
mustRemember: Re-NEET 2026 date: 21 June 2026. Cause: alleged question paper leak.
